inputPath.description: Absolute path to a non-recursive directory of assets, or to a single file (REQ-001).

rightsManifestPath.description: Optional job-level rights manifest keyed by normalized relative path. Per-asset `<file>.rights.yaml` sidecars take precedence over it.

sourceClassification.description: decisions.md D-36. Defaults to `fixture` when absent — the fail-closed choice, since a mislabelled fixture understates Phase 0 progress whereas a mislabelled real asset would inflate exit evidence.
